source.note: Baselines are observed search data, not traffic forecasts. Start each 28-day evaluation window on the first complete day after production release.

strategy: Build a 365-day transportation traffic engine while preserving separate canonical ownership for Mackinac Bridge toll intent and Mackinac Bridge live-conditions intent.

experiments.hypothesis: Pair the exact Mackinac Bridge toll head term with a calculator-led title and snippet emphasizing vehicle-specific RV, trailer and round-trip math that a bare-price SERP answer cannot resolve, while preserving the existing fare answer and calculator.

treatment.title: Mackinac Bridge Toll Calculator 2026 | Chris Izworski
treatment.metaDescription: Mackinac Bridge toll is $4 for a car ($2 per axle). Calculate RV, trailer and round-trip tolls, the 2.3% card fee, and MacPass's free 36-hour return.
treatment.h1: Mackinac Bridge Toll 2026: $4 for a Passenger Car
treatment.firstAnswer: The Mackinac Bridge toll is $4 one way for a standard two-axle passenger car in 2026, or $8 round trip at the standard rate.

experiments.stopCondition: Official Mackinac Bridge Authority fare changes, calculator formula regresses, canonical changes, or average position falls materially below page one.

preWindowContentChanges.from: Mackinac Bridge toll 2026: $4 one way for a standard car, $8 round trip. Calculate RV, trailer and motorhome costs from official axle rates.
preWindowContentChanges.to: Mackinac Bridge tolls for 2026: $4 passenger cars plus official RV, trailer and motorhome rates. Use the per-axle calculator before you cross.
preWindowContentChanges.rationale: Pre-release revision; the clock has not started. The page ran 1,190 impressions at 0.17% CTR from position 8.0 in the 28 days to Aug 29. The old description answered the query completely — '$4 one way, $8 round trip' — so a searcher asking what the toll costs had no reason to open it. The flat fare stays ON the page, where the gate requires it and where it is honest; the description now leads with the thing a result snippet cannot answer, which is what a specific vehicle with more than two axles pays. This is a hypothesis about snippet self-cannibalisation, not a measured result, and the window will test it.

preWindowContentChanges.to: Immediate $4 passenger-car answer plus round-trip and payment intent
preWindowContentChanges.rationale: Fresh GSC evidence changed the decision. The page grew from 3,097 to 5,463 impressions and 8 to 17 clicks with position essentially flat, but exact 'mackinac bridge toll' reached 778 impressions at position 9.98 with one click (0.13% CTR). At this volume the undercapture is no longer noise. Strengthen the existing toll canonical rather than creating another search owner.

preWindowContentChanges.field: title + metaDescription + FAQPage schema + contextual incoming links
preWindowContentChanges.from: Bare-price-led title and snippet; no FAQPage schema
preWindowContentChanges.to: Calculator-led exact requested metadata with five on-page FAQ entities; one trip-context incoming link each on Mackinac Island fall, U.P. fall, and Soo Locks. Bridge Live already links to tolls.
preWindowContentChanges.rationale: Owner-supplied 6,437 impressions and 15 clicks in 28 days at 8.3 average position; protect answer and calculator while distinguishing vehicle-specific math.

latest28DayBaseline20261012.source: Owner-supplied GSC Web report, last 28 days through approximately 2026-10-12
latest28DayBaseline20261012.assessment: Bare-price query cluster likely has significant zero-click intent; judge on qualified calculator clicks, aiming toward 1% CTR and top-five average position; not guaranteed.

experiments.hypothesis: Pairing official wait-time intent with the truthful live approach-camera intent already earning clicks will lift overall CTR while preserving the page's border-wait utility.
experiments.truthBoundary: The Gordie Howe operator currently says its own live camera feeds are coming soon. The page must label the displayed Ontario 511 image as a live approach camera, never as an operator bridge camera.
experiments.stopCondition: Official wait-time retrieval regresses, the Ontario 511 camera fails persistently, operator camera availability changes without the copy being updated, or the canonical changes.

protectedSurface.reason: Separate canonical owner for Mackinac Bridge live conditions. This toll CTR treatment must not change the live page's title, description, H1, direct-answer block, schema, canonical or indexability.
